name: B, T and dendritic cell surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface/identity signatures of naive and mature B cells, activated dendritic cells and Th1 CD4 T cells (plus butyrophilin surface interactions); the B cell signatures separate it from DC/monocyte/antigen-presentation neighbours, and the DC and T cell signatures from the B-cell-only neighbour.

name: Axon guidance via SLIT–ROBO, netrin, ephrin and L1
rationale: All members are axon guidance cues and their Rho GTPase effectors (SLIT–ROBO, netrin/DCC, ephrin, L1/CHL1, RAC/CDC42), lacking the semaphorin–plexin and DSCAM components of neighbouring guidance themes.

name: Renal tubular urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC transporter modules and their diseases centred on urate (SLC22A12, SLC2A9) and cystine (SLC3A1, SLC7A9) handling, distinguishing it from organic cation, hexose and neutral amino acid transport neighbours.

name: Presynaptic calcium-dependent modulation of glutamate release
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis and glutamate secretion, distinguishing it from GABA-secretion, G-protein presynaptic inhibition and active-zone vesicle-priming neighbours.

name: Glycolysis and gluconeogenesis with fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover glycolytic and gluconeogenic carbon flux including fructose, glycerol/alditol, pyruvate, oxaloacetate and alanine metabolism, unlike neighbours focused on glycogen, hexose transport and glucokinase/G6Pase.

name: Centromeric sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: All members concern establishing, maintaining and resolving (centromeric) sister chromatid cohesion in mitosis and meiosis, rather than the condensation, centromere assembly or spindle processes of neighbours.

name: PTK6 signaling with Hippo–YAP/TAZ regulation
rationale: Members are PTK6 (BRK) signaling events plus Hippo/YAP1–TAZ transcriptional control and cell-density sensing; the Hippo block is what neighbouring tyrosine-kinase themes lack.

name: Epithelial anion and water transport via SLC26 exchangers
rationale: Members are SLC26 anion exchange (sulfate, oxalate, iodide, chloride), aquaporin water flux and organic anion (pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate) transport, distinguishing it from CFTR, bicarbonate and cation-chloride cotransporter neighbours.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members describe microglial differentiation, activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity together with recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, which the amyloid-beta clearance neighbours lack.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling and ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing via RIG-I/MDA5 to TRAF3/6–IRF/NF-kB and type I interferon, its viral evasion, and ISG15 conjugation, which distinguishes it from DNA-sensing/TLR and interferon-response neighbours.

name: Trans-Golgi to endosome/lysosome trafficking and retrieval
rationale: Members cover Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, lysosomal vesicle biogenesis and late endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, unlike the COPI Golgi–ER and intra-Golgi trafficking neighbours.

name: NOTCH1 intracellular signaling and constitutively active cancer mutants
rationale: All members concern NOTCH1 NICD signaling and its oncogenic HD/PEST, translocation and FBXW7-loss activation, distinguishing it from NOTCH2–4 and generic Notch target themes.

name: B cell development, differentiation and proliferation
rationale: Members are B cell development, differentiation (including B-1) and proliferation, unlike neighbours centred on BCR signaling, germinal centre or memory B cells.

name: AMPA/kainate receptor transmission, clustering and excitotoxicity
rationale: Members are AMPA and kainate receptor activation, receptor trapping/clustering, short-term plasticity and kainate-induced hippocampal neuron death, unlike NMDA-receptor and presynaptic-modulation neighbours.

name: Hyperosmotic salt stress sensing and sodium import regulation
rationale: Members are hyperosmotic/salt stress and osmosensory responses plus aldosterone- and renin-linked restraint of sodium import, distinguishing it from potassium, hypotonic/water and blood-volume neighbours.

name: RAS–MAPK activation and phosphatase-mediated ERK feedback inactivation
rationale: Members span RAS/MRAS–SHOC2 and SOS-driven RAF activation and its termination by negative feedback and dual-specificity dephosphorylation of ERK, which RAS-GAP and BRAF-mutant neighbours lack.

qualifier: proximal tubule organic cation and dicarboxylate
name: Proximal tubule organic cation and dicarboxylate transport
rationale: Members are organic anion/cation and sodium-coupled di-/tricarboxylate, pyruvate and alpha-ketoglutarate transport with proximal tubule development, unlike the xenobiotic, malate-aspartate and succinate-only neighbours.

name: TGFBR3 coreceptor modulation of activin, TGF-beta and FGF2
rationale: Members are betaglycan (TGFBR3) regulation of TGF-beta, activin and FGF2 signaling plus follistatin antagonism of activin, distinguishing it from gonadotropin, SMAD-mutant and canonical TGF-beta neighbours.

qualifier: UDP-GlcNAc, sialic acid and dolichol phosphate
name: UDP-GlcNAc, sialic acid and dolichol-phosphate glycosylation donor synthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of sugar-nucleotide and lipid glycosylation donors (UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid, dolichyl phosphate) and their defects, unlike neighbours centred on N-glycan processing, GDP-mannose and nucleotide-sugar transport.

qualifier: organic anion uptake, glucuronidation and export
name: Hepatic drug and bilirubin uptake, glucuronidation and export
rationale: Members are SLCO/ABCC organic anion transport, UGT glucuronidation, heme/bilirubin catabolism and drug ADME, distinguishing it from SLC22, bile acid and phase I xenobiotic metabolism neighbours.

name: Morquio syndrome (MPS IV) glycosaminoglycan degradation defects
rationale: All three members are Morquio A/B forms of MPS IV, distinguishing it from Hurler, Hunter, Sanfilippo and Maroteaux-Lamy neighbours.

name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion establishment
rationale: Members combine cohesin loading, chromatin looping and cohesion establishment with DNA unwinding, polymerase activity and break-induced replication, unlike condensation/centromere and E2F replication-initiation neighbours.

name: Somite segmentation and embryonic limb and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members are somitogenesis, axis elongation and segment patterning plus limb, digit and joint morphogenesis, which neighbours centred on Nodal asymmetry, Hox clusters and neural plate lack.

name: Immediate-early stress response to UV, TNF and phorbol ester
rationale: Members are UV, TNF/NF-kB and PMA-induced immediate-early (NR4A) and growth-arrest gene programmes, distinguishing it from senescence, AP-1 and light-response neighbours.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification with protein hydroxylation
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, anticodon-loop modifications (wybutosine, wobble thiolation) and protein lysine hydroxylation/diphthamide, unlike neighbours centred on RNA methylation and pseudouridylation.
